The '''cyber-claw hand''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic implant]] manufactured by [[CyTac]]. It replaced an individual's [[Limb/Legends|arm]] and could increase their strength. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sibarra]] was fitted with a cyber-claw hand.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
